PaddleOCR PP-OCRv4 running on onnxruntime-web.

ocr.bundle.mjs  esbuild bundle of @gutenye/ocr-browser 1.4.8 + onnxruntime-web
                1.27.0, committed prebuilt so the site needs no build step.
                Exports { Ocr, ortEnv }.
models/         @gutenye/ocr-models 1.4.2 (PP-OCRv4 detection + recognition,
                PP-OCR mobile v2.0 angle classifier, Chinese/ASCII dictionary)
ort-wasm-simd-threaded.wasm
                onnxruntime-web 1.27.0 WASM kernel.

Threads are disabled at runtime: SharedArrayBuffer needs COOP/COEP headers,
which GitHub Pages cannot send.
